description: This C# source file defines the ExceptionMiddleware class, which is a custom middleware in an ASP.NET Core application for handling exceptions globally during HTTP request processing. It catches exceptions thrown by downstream middleware or request handlers and returns appropriate JSON error responses, including handling specific 'DuplicateException' cases.

classes.name: ExceptionMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware component for capturing and handling exceptions during HTTP request processing in ASP.NET Core.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Main method invoked per request, it awaits the next middleware and catches exceptions to delegate to error handler.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Handles exceptions by inspecting their type and returning appropriate JSON responses with proper status codes.
